definitions.gloss: the act or quality of waking up
definitions.explanation: describes how one wakes up, whether refreshed or groggy

examples.japanese: ⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{寝覚|ねざ}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: If I drink too much, I wake up feeling bad.

examples.japanese: ⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{寝|ね}た→寝る：00470_neru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{寝覚|ねざ}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すっきり→すっきり：05180_sukkiri⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I went to bed early, so I woke up feeling refreshed.

notes:
SLEEP VOCABULARY:
{寝覚|ねざ}め is the nominalized form of {寝覚|ねざ}める (to wake up from sleep). It describes the quality of waking up.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {寝覚|ねざ}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧/よい - to wake up feeling good/refreshed
- {寝覚|ねざ}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ - to wake up feeling bad/groggy
- {寝覚|ねざ}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すっきり→すっきり：05180_sukkiri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to wake up feeling refreshed
{寝覚|ねざ}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ can also mean "to feel guilty" or "to have something on one's conscience."
- ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧{寝覚|ねざ}め⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ - Doing such a thing would weigh on my conscience.

CONTRAST WITH {寝|ね}つき:
- ⟦{寝|ね}つき→寝つき：08548_netsuki⟧ - how well you fall asleep
- {寝覚|ねざ}め - how well you wake up

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{目覚|めざ}め→目覚め：13676_mezame⟧ - awakening (more general)
- ⟦{起床|きしょう}→起床：00237_kishou⟧ - getting up
- ⟦{熟睡|じゅくすい}→熟睡：11079_jukusui⟧ - deep sleep
